OpenBubble.note: The actual tooltip bubble, photographed. TooltipPrimitive is the Radix root and accepts defaultOpen, which the styled Tooltip does not — popover/96 fill, hairline ring, popover shadow and text-ui medium ink are all visible.

Sides.note: side='top' / 'bottom' / 'right' each rendered open at once, so the placement axis is legible in a still frame.

CompoundLabel.note: Rich content inside the bubble: a label + ShortcutBadge row over a muted second line, with max-w-xs wrapping.

TriggerRow.note: Resting triggers under a 150 ms provider delay — the closed state of the same composition.
